02The commercial problem

Hotels can have excellent spas, treatments, fitness, partners and facilities and still struggle to turn that wellness investment into clear commercial demand.

More wellness is not automatically better wellness. The opportunity is turning what the property offers into an offer the right guests understand, value and choose.

06How it works

Strategic Wellness Advisory. Turning your investment into clear commercial demand.

Strategic

ALT‑15° works alongside senior leadership, providing ongoing strategic input as decisions arise.

Focused

The engagement is intentionally senior and focused. The hotel retains execution and operational ownership.

The challenge

Hotels invest heavily in wellness, then struggle to turn it into revenue. Facilities look like every competitor’s, sit underused and are never packaged into an offer guests understand or teams can sell.

The value

ALT‑15° identifies where wellness investment is losing value, then defines what to offer, who it’s for, and how to package, price and sell it to drive guest spend, ancillary revenue and repeat stays.

ALT‑15° does not run the spa, manage therapists, organise rotas, procure products, manage day‑to‑day operations
or replace the hotel’s operational team.

What sets ALT‑15° apart

ALT‑15° brings together wellness expertise and commercial strategy, two disciplines that rarely work together closely enough in hospitality.

We don’t replace a hotel’s spa, clinical or operational specialists. We work alongside leadership to identify where wellness investment could deliver greater value, then define what to prioritise, who it’s for, and how to position, package, price and sell it.

So wellness becomes a compelling reason to choose the hotel, spend more during the stay and return.
